layout.arrangement: Red title centered at top. Below it, one large red-bordered rectangle (the diagram canvas) fills nearly the whole slide. Inside: 'Training Data' ellipse top-center; a horizontal pipeline row across the middle reading left-to-right: Input Samples -> dashed red container holding 4 stacked-side-by-side boxes (Pre processing, Feature Extraction, Feature Selection, Classification) -> Predicted Labels -> vertical 'Prediction Error (Loss Function)' box -> Samples Labels. Green dashed feedback arrows sweep from bottom-right up into the 4 container boxes. A light-green annotation box sits bottom-center with a thick red up-arrow above it. A yellow starburst with 'The BIG challenge' sits bottom-right with a thick red up-arrow pointing to the Prediction Error box. A solid black strip runs along the very bottom edge of the slide.

visual_elements.description: End-to-end deep learning pipeline. Nodes left-to-right: (1) 'Input Samples' tan rectangle; red arrow -> (2) red dashed rounded container (light peach fill) holding four rectangles connected by red arrows: 'Pre processing' (pale yellow), 'Feature Extraction' (pale blue), 'Feature Selection' (pale green), 'Classification' (dark red, white text); red arrow -> (3) 'Predicted Labels' pale-lavender rectangle; red arrow -> (4) vertical pink rectangle 'Prediction Error (Loss Function)' which also receives a leftward red arrow from (5) 'Samples Labels' tan rectangle on the far right; a red arrow continues from Predicted Labels toward Samples Labels past the error box. From the 'Training Data' tan ellipse at top-center: a solid dark-blue curved arrow exits its left dot, sweeps left and down, arrowhead pointing down into 'Input Samples'; a dotted dark-blue curved arrow exits its right dot, sweeps right and down, arrowhead pointing down into 'Samples Labels'. Four green dashed curved arrows originate near the base of the Prediction Error/red up-arrow zone and curve up-left, arrowheads pointing up into the bottoms of Pre processing, Feature Extraction, Feature Selection, and Classification (feedback/training signal). A thick red block arrow points up from the green annotation box toward the Classification/feedback area; a second thick red block arrow points up from the starburst into the 'Prediction Error (Loss Function)' box.

'Prediction Error (Loss Function)' is bold red, rotated 90 degrees (vertical, reading bottom-to-top). Green annotation text is sentence-case green with 'MINIMIZE' bolded.
